Production

Quality shows in the details.

From fabric choice to the last stitch, we approve every step with a sample and carry the same standard into bulk.

Process

From idea to shipment in five steps.

When a step is complete you hear from us, with photos and inspection results. When you have a question, you have one contact.

  1. 1

    Design / idea

    Your R&D file, sketch, tech pack or a sample product. We choose fabric and trims together.

    You receiveMaterials list

  2. 2

    Sample

    See it, touch it and try it before approval.

    You receiveSample photos and approval

  3. 3

    Production

    To the approved sample’s standard, on the planned schedule.

    You receiveDelivery schedule

  4. 4

    Quality control

    In-line and final checks; problems are solved before they reach your warehouse.

    You receiveInspection results

  5. 5

    Packing & shipment

    Labels, packing and cartons to your procedure; shipped with partner carriers.

    You receiveDispatch and tracking details

Your order never goes dark.

When a step is complete you hear from us, with photos and inspection results. On the cutting table we plan fabric to the pattern and fill the gaps with the same client's other products: less waste, lower cost.

in Denizli's textile industry since

About

Denizli's textile know-how, for today's brands.

We built our experience with Denizli's leading textile companies from 1995 and brought it together under the Berke Tekstil name in 2015.

Today we manufacture for brands from design to shipment, and grow our own home textile brand, Fronte Home. That is why we know what makes a product sell.

From Istanbul to Germany, we work with brands looking for a partner to make their own collection.

  1. 1995
    The start

    Production experience with Denizli's leading textile companies.

  2. 2015
    Berke Tekstil

    Our experience under our own name; contract and private label manufacturing.

  3. Today
    Fronte Home

    Our own home textile brand, where we test fabrics and finishes on real customers.

  4. 2027
    Heimtextil, Frankfurt

    We will be at the fair with our samples on 12–15 January 2027. Write to us to meet.
